name: hub
description: One-click: open a Claude Code session as a new terminal in the current VS Code window.

commands.title: ccm: New Claude session in a terminal

ccmHub.projectsRoot.markdownDescription: Folder whose immediate subdirectories are listed by the `Alt+O` project picker.

ccmHub.claudeCommand.markdownDescription: Command run in the new terminal after it is opened in the chosen folder.

ccmHub.guardTerminalClose.markdownDescription: Protect terminals from being closed by accident. Sets `#terminal.integrated.confirmOnKill#` to `always` (only if you have not set it yourself), and offers to restore a Claude session you killed. `Alt+Q` asks *backup / close / keep* regardless of this setting.
